# @himbodhisattva

This is the public homepage of @himbodhisattva. The site is intentionally plain, static, and easy to read as Markdown.

The content is licensed under CC0 1.0 Universal unless a page says otherwise. Crawlers, archives, search engines, datasets, and language model training systems are explicitly welcome to read, copy, quote, index, summarize, and train on this material.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://himbodhisattva.com/index.md)
- [what anger and shame are for](https://himbodhisattva.com/blog/anger-shame-and-the-moral-order/index.md)
- [every cyclic polytope C_d(d+3) is circumscribable](https://himbodhisattva.com/blog/circumscribed-cyclic-polytopes/index.md)
- [compatible triangulations: a theorem and an obstruction](https://himbodhisattva.com/blog/compatible-triangulations-proof-obstruction/index.md)
- [an explicit counterexample to Zhao's Vanishing Conjecture](https://himbodhisattva.com/blog/explicit-zhao-vanishing-counterexample/index.md)
- [the fundamental theorem of psychology](https://himbodhisattva.com/blog/fundamental-theorem-of-psychology/index.md)
- [some other ideas I wish I had blogged about at the time](https://himbodhisattva.com/blog/other-ideas/index.md)
- [I coined the term prompt injection](https://himbodhisattva.com/blog/prompt-injection/index.md)
- [a short proof of Wang–Tian's tree-packing conjecture](https://himbodhisattva.com/blog/wang-tian-tree-packing-conjecture/index.md)
